name: Lens of Truth
description: Sheikah artifact that reveals invisible platforms, fake walls, hidden enemies, and illusions. Essential for Shadow Temple and Spirit Temple.

customData.lore: Created by the Sheikah to see through deception. The eye sees what the mind cannot. Drains magic while active.
puzzleUses: Reveal invisible platforms in Shadow Temple
Expose hidden enemies (Dead Hand, Bongo Bongo)
Find true path in illusion mazes
